skill.summary: Create images from text prompts. Use when you need to generate/draw/create images based on descriptions.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of coze-image-gen.

- Generate high-quality images from text prompts via command line.
- Supports single, batch, and sequential ("story mode") image creation.
- Customizable image sizes, including presets and custom dimensions.
- Outputs direct image URLs to stdout.
- Random prompt generation available if prompt not specified.
